what_happened: Scene: layout/style 10; eggplant_4 (veg0) and eggplant_3 (veg1) on the middle shelf, steak_5 (round, upper shelf, meat0) and steak_6 (T-bone, meat1, upper shelf); two tupperwares side by side on the marble counter right of the fridge, next to the toaster. Stage 0, first attempt: closed on the T-bone steak meat1 at 71-79, lifted it hanging by one edge (120-204); while the arm moved out of the fridge, the fingers closed past it (close 196, width 0.003) and it fell at ~206-208 down through the fridge to the floor (end z 0.007). From then on only three items were reachable, so stage 3 was impossible. The policy did not react: it drove the empty closed fingers to the counter (~400, empty place over a tupperware). Then it placed eggplant veg1 (grasp 613-619, release 788) into the left tupperware A (stage 0 complete 813, typical 286), the round steak meat0 (grasp 1028-1036, release 1198) into A too (A = veg + meat, correct; stage 1 at 1220), and the second eggplant veg0 (grasp 1428-1436, release 1626) again into A next to the first eggplant (stage 2 at 1645), leaving the right tupperware B empty. 1700-2600: back to the fridge, hovering at the empty upper shelf; at the end back at the counter. Final: A = 2 eggplants + steak, B empty, T-bone on the floor.
causal_chain: T-bone held by its edge slipped out at ~207 and fell to the floor (first item) -> 4th item unreachable, stage 3 impossible -> empty trip (~400) -> three correct-looking placements, the third (second eggplant, 1626) into the tupperware that already held an eggplant and the steak -> stage 3 never true
self_recovery: Recovered from the drop by placing the other three items (stage 0-2 completed 813-1645), but it never tried to retrieve the floor steak, and the third placement chose the full tupperware.
